indications_and_usage: Uses Anti-acne Tighten skin Moisturize Improve fine lines Whitening
do_not_use: Do not use Do not use on damaged or broken skin. Avoid contact with eyes when using this product. Rinse with water to remove.
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if • The condition worsens or does not improve after 7 days of use. • Excessive skin irritation, redness, burning, or peeling occurs. • Signs of allergic reaction develop, such as rash, itching, or swelling. • The product is accidentally ingested.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical help immediately or contact a poison control center.
dosage_and_administration: Directions Apply thin layer on acne-prone/oily areas after cleansing. Use 1–2 times daily, preferably at night; sunscreen during day. Start every other day; increase frequency if tolerated. Reduce use or add moisturizer if dryness/peeling occurs.
other_safety_information: Other information Store in a cool place.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients POLYGONATUM ODORATUM ROOT, ANGELICA DAHURICA ROOT, BOMBYX MORI WHOLE, COIX LACRYMA-JOBI (JOB'S TEARS) SEED OIL, MUNG BEAN, PEARL (HYRIOPSIS CUMINGII), 1,3-PROPANEDIOL, GLYCERIN, CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE, CETEARYL ALCOHOL, EDETATE DISODIUM, CARBOMER 940, NIACINAMIDE, PANTHENOL, AMINOMETHYL PROPANOL, PHENOXYETHANOL, WATER,
